items.headline: Procter & Gamble will add fully automated shifts at 15 plants to cut labor costs
items.summary: The consumer‑goods giant plans to run its factories around the clock without human oversight by 2027, expanding a pilot program that already operates at fifteen sites. The move aims to lower production expenses but raises questions about workforce displacement.
